A common failure mode in local LLM servers is process termination or connection drop (`socket hang up`). The Go implementation addresses this through:

1. **Child Process Supervisor**: Spawns inference worker with a bidirectional health channel.
2. **Crash Interception**: Captures exit codes, logs crash telemetry, and restarts the worker in sub-500ms without dropping pending HTTP connections.
3. **Graceful Connection Draining**: Holds inbound requests in an in-memory queue during transient reloads.

---

The local repository already houses the foundation of this architecture in `cmd/strata-server/`:

- **Main Entrypoint**: `cmd/strata-server/main.go` initializes the model configuration, tokenization engine, and HTTP server.
- **Engine Process Supervisor**: `cmd/strata-server/engine/engine.go` coordinates `strata.exe` with `CREATE_NO_WINDOW` headless flags, handles the line-based IPC protocol, and captures stderr logs.
- **Hardware Config & Environment Builder**: `cmd/strata-server/engine/config.go` maps `strata-qwen177b.json` parameters, injects ROCm library paths (`C:\Program Files\AMD\ROCm\7.2\bin`), and builds execution arguments.

nodes.id: C:\Users\Butch\Documents\02_Apps\Strata\docs-strix-go\STRATA_KERNEL_ARCHITECTURE.md::1. Disjoint MoE Expert Caching & Asynchronous Overlap::7
nodes.name: 1. Disjoint MoE Expert Caching & Asynchronous Overlap

metadata.body:
Traditional MoE implementations require all weights to reside entirely in high-bandwidth GPU memory. A 177-billion parameter model with 48 layers and 24,576 total experts requires over 90 GB of memory:

```
[ Model Layer ] -> Top-10 Router
                      |
        +-------------+-------------+
        |                           |
[ VRAM Expert Cache ]        [ Pinned Host RAM ]
  (~3,000 Hot Experts)         (All 24,576 Experts)
        |                           |
  GPU Execution               CPU Execution
 (Radeon 8060S / HIP)        (Ryzen AI Max Zen 5 AVX-512)
        \                           /
         +------------+------------+
                      |
            Combined Output State
```

Instead of traditional softmax self-attention which scales with quadratic memory and compute $O(N^2)$, the Qwen 3.8 Flash-Next architecture employs Gated Delta Net (GDN) linear attention with $O(1)$ memory complexity per decode step:

$$\mathbf{S}_t = \beta_t \mathbf{S}_{t-1} + \mathbf{k}_t \mathbf{v}_t^T, \quad \mathbf{o}_t = \mathbf{q}_t \mathbf{S}_t$$

nodes.id: C:\Users\Butch\Documents\02_Apps\Strata\docs-strix-go\STRATA_KERNEL_ARCHITECTURE.md::3. Prefix Lookup Engine (PLE) & Direct NVMe I/O::48
nodes.name: 3. Prefix Lookup Engine (PLE) & Direct NVMe I/O

metadata.body: The Prefix Lookup Engine (PLE) leverages a pre-computed 28.8 GB n-gram table to ground predictions and accelerate repeated phrase lookups.

Strata incorporates a dual-mode speculative decoding pipeline:
Speculative Drafter Draft Length Verification Mechanism Measured Yield & Acceleration
MTP Layer (Draft Head) 5 to 7 tokens (--spec 7) Full 48-layer parallel verification pass (--mtp-q4 head, --coupled-draft) 74% to 95.5% acceptance; 78.9 to 86.2 tok/s engine decode (82.1 to 89.8 tok/s client decode) on Strix Halo Pass 7.
Prompt Lookup & Think Ring Up to 7 tokens (--lookup-chain 3) N-gram match against prompt context + dynamic <think> ring (STRATA_LOOKUP_THINK_RING=1) +6% to +11% speedup on code edits, tool calls, and deliberative reasoning chains.

Long-context inference (32K to 256K tokens) normally saturates VRAM with KV cache tensors:

- **KV Streaming (`--kv-resident 32768`)**: Only the active attention window (e.g. 32K cells) resides in VRAM. Older KV context is stored in system RAM and streamed over the UMA bus as needed, freeing up multiple gigabytes of VRAM for hundreds of additional cached MoE experts.
- **Int8 KV Cache (`--kv int8`)**: Standard production baseline, zero perplexity degradation.
- **Hadamard-Rotated 4-Bit KV (`--kv q4_0` / `--kv k8v4`)**: Multiplies key/value vectors by an orthogonal Hadamard matrix prior to 4-bit quantization, eliminating outliers and reducing KV memory consumption by 23–50%.

When generating at non-zero temperature, standard sampling causes the draft and target models to diverge. Strata implements Gumbel-max coupling:
$$t^* = \arg\max_i \left( \frac{p_i}{E_i} \right)$$
where $E_i \sim \text{Exp}(1)$ is exponential noise pseudo-randomly keyed by token ID, seed, and position. This forces the drafter and verifier to agree on identical candidate tokens, raising acceptance from 52.8% to **59.9%** (+9% net throughput).

---

- **`STRATA_GDN_HEAD` & `STRATA_GDN_PP=2`**: Parallelizes state updates across 4 SIMD lanes per column with 2 columns per lane, achieving **+2.9%** speedup on 64K context prompts.
- **`STRATA_GDN_CONVL2`**: Fuses the 1D short temporal convolution and query/key L2 normalization into a single memory pass, eliminating redundant global memory round-trips.
- **`STRATA_GDN_SPLIT`**: Distributes the decode-time GDN state update across 4 threadblocks per attention head.

---

1. **Disjoint Partitioning**: At any time, GPU VRAM holds the top-k most frequently routed experts, while system RAM holds the entire pool of 24,576 experts (page-locked via `VirtualLock` on Windows).
2. **True Concurrent Execution**: When a token routes to experts not present in VRAM, the GPU dispatches its resident experts on HIP while the CPU simultaneously executes the missing experts in place using multi-threaded AVX-512 / AVX2 kernels. Neither device waits on the other.
3. **Adaptive Conversation Cache**: During interactive sessions, Strata tracks expert routing frequencies. In the background (`--adapt-async 1`), a dedicated helper thread swaps cold VRAM experts back to RAM and promotes hot experts to VRAM without stalling decode cycles.
4. **Exchange Rotation (`STRATA_EXCHANGE_ROTATE=1`)**: Eliminates buffer copying by simply swapping pointer ownership between host and device page-locked exchange slots.

---

This document breaks down the core algorithmic breakthroughs and kernel designs that enable [Niko1221/Strata](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata.git) to execute massive 177B Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models at high speed on consumer and workstation hardware.

---

Reading rows through standard OS memory-mapped files (`mmap`) causes kernel page-cache contention, memory inflation, and page faults:

- **Direct I/O Solution**: Strata opens the n-gram file using Win32 `CreateFileW` with flags:
  ```cpp
  FILE_FLAG_NO_BUFFERING | FILE_FLAG_OVERLAPPED | FILE_FLAG_RANDOM_ACCESS
  ```
- **I/O Completion Ports (IOCP)**: An asynchronous thread pool (`STRATA_IO_THREADS`, default 4 on Windows) issues queued reads directly into aligned memory buffers allocated via `VirtualAlloc`.
- **Performance**: Achieves **122.3 ms** average seek-and-read latency directly from NVMe SSD at queue depth, with zero bytes of OS file cache bloat.

---

AMD Strix Halo represents a paradigm shift in local LLM inference by integrating a massive GPU onto a single unified memory bus with low-latency CPU access:

- **Host Processor**: AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (16 Zen 5 physical cores, 32 execution threads, AVX-512 support).
- **Integrated GPU Accelerator**: AMD Radeon 8060S (40 RDNA 3.5 Compute Units, 2560 stream processors, target `gfx1151`, PCI Device ID `1002:1586`).
- **Memory Architecture**: 128 GB Unified LPDDR5X-8533 on a 256-bit wide bus delivering **273 GB/s** peak memory bandwidth shared dynamically between CPU and GPU.
- **Wavefront Size**: Native Wave32 execution mode.
- **Matrix Hardware**: Hardware WMMA (Wave Matrix Multiply Accumulate) matrix cores natively supporting INT4, INT8, BF16, and FP16 dot products.
- **Software Stack**: AMD ROCm 7.x (ROCm 7.14 / ROCm 10.2 nightly) with hipBLAS, rocBLAS, and hipBLASLt.

---
Unlike discrete GPUs (e.g. RX 7900 XTX with dedicated GDDR6 VRAM over PCIe), Strix Halo shares one continuous pool of physical RAM:

When Strata initializes on GPU 0, `src/core/arch_defaults.cpp` automatically applies 18 specialized runtime environment switches if `gfx1151` is detected. > [!IMPORTANT] > **Zero Divergence Guarantee**: Every single one of these 18 switches was verified to produce **byte-identical output tokens** (matching token IDs bit-for-bit against the unoptimized reference implementation).
Switch Name Default Pipeline Phase Performance Impact & Mechanism
STRATA_GDN_HEAD 1 Prompt Gated Delta Net recurrence: 4 SIMD lanes per column + grid-stride norm fusion.
STRATA_GDN_PP 2 Prompt Two columns per lane in GDN recurrence; improves 64K prompt processing by +2.9%.
STRATA_GDN_CONVL2 1 Prompt Fuses 1D short convolution and query/key L2 normalization into a single launch (-0.3s at 64K).
STRATA_GDN_NOY 1 Prompt Eliminates dead FP32 global memory store of normalization output.
STRATA_CVEC_FUSE 1 Prompt Fuses steered layer write, control vector injection, and subsequent layer normalization in one pass.
STRATA_HCD_EXACT 1

nodes.name: 4. Opt-In Matrix Core (WMMA) & Pass 7 Production Switches

metadata.body:
These switches leverage the hardware RDNA 3.5 WMMA matrix accelerators and Pass 6/7 custom kernels (`strata-qwen177b.json`). Because floating-point summation order differs from scalar accumulation, WMMA switches are opt-in and enforced fail-closed by `docs-strix-go/validator.go`:
Opt-In Switch Value Acceleration Domain Description & Numeric Impact
STRATA_PF_FUSED 1 Prompt MoE Dispatches prompt experts directly to INT8 WMMA matrix cores with variable tiles (BM=64/32/16, STRATA_MOE_MAX_BM=64). Note: STRATA_PF_F16 must remain 0 (Invariant F-01).
STRATA_PREFILL_STREAM_MIN 16 (<= 128) Sub-1K Cliff Guard Eliminates the 1,024-token MMQ fallback cliff when all 24,576 experts are resident in UMA VRAM.
STRATA_PF_GEMM / STRATA_WMMA_GEMM 1 Prompt Projections Computes FP16 projections on 128x256 WMMA GEMM above STRATA_PF_SWITCH_MIN_T and 64x64_4w WMMA below it.
STRATA_PF_HCDOWN 1 Hyper-Connection Pass 6 custom WMMA hyper-connection down projection on the prompt path.
STRATA_HC_UPMIX 1 Hyper-Connection Fuses hyper-connection up projection directly with its activation epilogue.
To avoid falling back to slow generic hipBLAS GEMM, Strata pre-calibrates the exact GEMM solution IDs for `gfx1151`.

When running on Windows 11 with Strix Halo:

1. **Local DLL Precedence Rule**: Windows search order prioritizes the application directory over `C:\Windows\System32`. Certain AMD Adrenalin drivers install an incompatible `amdhip64_7.dll` in System32 that segfaults on prompt submission. **Always place `amdhip64_7.dll` and `amd_comgr.dll` directly in the same folder as `strata.exe`**.
2. **Stale HIP Error Reset**: In `src/prefill/gemm.cu`, Windows hipBLAS occasionally leaves `hipErrorInvalidValue` set after non-fatal BF16 GEMMs. The Windows engine explicitly clears this stale error flag with `hipGetLastError()` following each successful GEMM.
3. **Host Pointer Alias**: On Windows, `hipHostGetDevicePointer` returns the host virtual address directly. Direct device-to-device DMA into mapped host memory is bypassed in favor of synchronous pinned host copies.

nodes.name: AMD Strix Halo (Ryzen AI Max+ 395 / gfx1151) Optimization Deep Dive

metadata.body:
This document provides an exhaustive technical analysis of the hardware architecture, memory subsystem, execution switches, and kernel optimizations for **AMD Strix Halo** (`gfx1151`) within the [Niko1221/Strata](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata.git) inference engine.

---

```powershell
$env:STRATA_HIPBLASLT_TUNING = "C:\Users\Butch\Documents\02_Apps\Strata\tools\hip\gfx1151-hipblaslt-100500.txt"
```

When active, Strata confirms during startup:
```text
prefill gemm: hipBLASLt tuning enabled (90 rows, gfx1151, version 100500)
```

---

- The Linux kernel exposes unified memory via the GTT (Graphics Translation Table) pool.
- With kernel boot parameters `ttm.pages_limit=29360128 ttm.page_pool_size=29360128`, up to **112 GiB** of RAM is mapped to the GPU, leaving the remaining memory for the OS.
- Strata's `device_free_bytes()` reads `MemAvailable` minus a headroom reserve (`STRATA_UMA_HEADROOM_GIB=6`, default 6 GiB) instead of conventional `MemFree`, preventing premature out-of-memory errors.

- `tools/hip/gfx1151-hipblaslt-100500.txt` (for ROCm 7.x / hipBLASLt 1.5.0)
- `tools/hip/gfx1151-hipblaslt-100401.txt` (for ROCm 7.14.1 / hipBLASLt 1.4.1)

- On Windows 10/11, the display driver model (WDDM 3.x) assigns a dedicated VRAM carve-out (typically 2–16 GB in BIOS) plus a shared memory budget (typically 50% to 85% of total system RAM).
- In `src/platform/memory.cpp`, Strata queries **DXGI 1.4** via `IDXGIAdapter3::QueryVideoMemoryInfo` with `DXGI_MEMORY_SEGMENT_GROUP_NON_LOCAL`.
- This ensures `--expert-cache auto` scales dynamically without exceeding the OS video budget, avoiding catastrophic page-thrashing where decode throughput drops from 54 tok/s to 30 tok/s.

- In `src/platform/memory.cpp`, resident weights are pinned using Win32 `SetProcessWorkingSetSizeEx` combined with `VirtualLock` in 1 GiB chunks:
  $$\text{WorkingSet}_{\text{min}} = \text{CurrentWS} + \text{ModelBytes} + 512\text{ MiB}$$
- This guarantees that Windows never pages expert blobs to disk during active inference rounds.

---

Domain Primary Keywords Target Code Files Git Log Command
Strix Halo & APU gfx1151, strix, halo, 8060S src/core/arch_defaults.cpp
docs/STRIX_HALO.md		 git log --grep="gfx1151" -i --oneline
Matrix Acceleration wmma, hipblaslt, 100500 src/prefill/wmma_gemm.cu
tools/hip/gfx1151-hipblaslt-*.txt		 git log --grep="hipblaslt" -i --oneline
Linear Attention gdn, delta_net, convl2 src/kernels/cuda/gdn.cu
src/kernels/cuda/native_gdn.cu		 git log --grep="gdn" -i --oneline
Direct SSD I/O direct_file, iocp, overlapped src/platform/direct_file.cpp
src/ngram/ple_reader.cpp		 git log --grep="direct_file" -i --oneline
Unified Memory / RAM virtuallock, gtt, dxgi, wddm src/platform/memory.cpp
src/core/expert_cache.cpp		 git log --grep="memory" -i --oneline
Speculative Decoding mtp, gumbel, suffix_drafter src/core/mtp.cpp
src/spec/controller.cpp		 git log --grep="spec" -i --oneline

metadata.body:
Use `strata-tracker.exe` for instant local searching:

```powershell
# Search commits and file paths matching any keyword
.\docs-strix-go\strata-tracker.exe search gfx1151
.\docs-strix-go\strata-tracker.exe search hipblaslt
.\docs-strix-go\strata-tracker.exe search gdn
.\docs-strix-go\strata-tracker.exe search direct_file
.\docs-strix-go\strata-tracker.exe search wmma
```
